meta.title: Kenya: IEBC registered voters 2022 by constituency and candidates by position (institution and geography level)
meta.rule: Geography- and institution-level facts only. No candidate-level votes, no scores or ratings of individuals. Candidate vote columns present in source files were deliberately not extracted.

iebc_registered_voters_2022_by_constitue.conflict: National total in this file is 22,102,532 (Kenyan constituencies only). Media and IEBC notices cite 22,120,458 for the full register; the 17,926 difference is not explained in this file (possibly diaspora and prison registrations, unverified). Show both with sources.

not_staged.status: Left out of the site (owner rule: publish only with caveats or leave out). That election was annulled by the Supreme Court on 1 September 2017; the copy found is unsigned; its 48 county rows add to 19,611,457 registered and 15,114,574 valid votes against a national total row of 19,611,423 and 15,114,622.
